operations.title: Entry 1167 — The Four-Site Total-Energy Boundary Is a Quartic Double Solid
operations.path: src/ledger/20260820-1167 The Four-Site Total-Energy Boundary Is a Quartic Double Solid.md

operations.title: The four-site q_G infinity coefficient is a singular quartic double solid
operations.body: Because q_G=sum x_i has edge rank zero, its residue leaves four edge variables and a P3 infinity base. The quartic double cover is a quartic double solid; the smooth benchmark has b3=20 and h21=10. The actual branch is singular at the physical diagonal Delta=0. Entries 1154-1155 apply only after an edge-dependent residue.

operations.title: Del Pezzo classification narrowed to edge-dependent residue sectors
operations.body: Entries 1154-1155 do not classify the total-energy q_G sector because q_G eliminates no edge variable.

authority_basis.summary: Admit the correction separating the q_G quartic-double-solid sector from edge-residue del Pezzo geometry.
